svg.text: errorStrategy 'ignore' in the shipped config: a failed ingestion is logged in .nextflow.log and

text.font-family: Virgil GS, Virgil, Excalifont, Comic Sans MS, Bradley Hand, cursive

svg.text: never fails the pipeline. CI sets terminate instead, so a broken module cannot pass.

text.font-family: Virgil GS, Virgil, Excalifont, Comic Sans MS, Bradley Hand, cursive

svg.text: DEPICTIO_SERVICES_PREFIX unset: local up behaves as before (py-rattler into <home>/env); a mismatch is an error, never a fallback download
